source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    nonzero = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    candidates = []
    for axis in ("sum", "diff"):
        groups = {}
        for r, c, color in nonzero:
            key = r + c if axis == "sum" else c - r
            groups.setdefault(key, set()).add(color)
        conflicts = sum(len(colors) - 1 for colors in groups.values())
        candidates.append((conflicts, len(groups), axis, groups))
    _, period, axis, groups = min(candidates, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))
    pattern = {}
    for key, colors in groups.items():
        residue = key % period
        color = next(iter(colors))
        if residue in pattern and pattern[residue] != color:
            raise ValueError("inconsistent diagonal pattern")
        pattern[residue] = color
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            key = r + c if axis == "sum" else c - r
            row.append(pattern[key % period])
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
